anomalies.observed: R8, the pull-up in the MAX3485 A/B bias network, is drawn with value 2.2M (2.2 MΩ).
anomalies.expected: The specification lists R8 as 2.2k (2.2 kΩ) in the R6/R7/R8/R15 bias/pull network on the MAX3485 A/B lines.

evidence.quote: R8 2.2M (bias resistor from +3V3 to the MAX3485 A/B line, sheet 1)
R6, R7, R8, R15 | 2k, 20k, 2.2k, 2.2k | Bias/pull network on the MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line.

anomalies.impact: The bias/pull resistor on the RS-485 A/B line is three orders of magnitude larger than intended, so the differential pair is only very weakly biased. When the half-duplex bus is idle the line can float instead of sitting at a defined fail-safe level, which can produce spurious start bits and unreliable communication with the serial servos.

parsed.summary: The schematic matches the specification for almost every component, but R8 in the MAX3485 A/B bias network is drawn as 2.2 MΩ instead of the specified 2.2 kΩ, which would leave the RS-485 bus weakly biased and prone to floating when idle.
